name: update-playbooks
tagline_zh: 上游文档变了，你的 playbook 还停在旧版本。自动比对安装步骤，重定向失效链接，同步社区插件版本，一次刷新。
tagline_en: Upstream docs moved, your playbook didn't. Auto-diff install steps, fix dead links, realign pins with brew's.
desc_en: (project) Use when refreshing install tasks in playbooks/roles/ against upstream docs — bumping a pinned version, adopting a newly recommended install method, repointing a doc link that moved, or realigning the community.general pin with the brew-installed ansible
why_zh: 它直接读上游文档做差异比对，而非靠正则猜；连 brew 安装的 ansible 版本都对齐，细节控福音。
why_en: Diffs against live upstream docs, not regex guesses; even aligns with brew-installed ansible versions—obsessive but right.
